description: Save the customer's details for this order. Pass every detail in its OWN field, already separated: first_name, last_name, email, phone, line1 (street and number), line2 (floor and door), postcode, city, region, country, company and vat_id. Put only the value in each field, never the label or the sentence around it. Use text only as a last resort, when you cannot tell the details apart. It saves what is valid and returns what it understood, what is wrong and what is still missing. Never invent a value: ask for what was not said.

address_id.description: One of the saved_addresses ids of checkout_status (customers with an account)

city.description: The city or town only. Only if the customer gave it.

company.description: The company name ONLY when a company buys and needs the invoice in its name ("Invoice to company X", "Factura a nombre de X"); then vat_id is required too. The name of an office, hotel or association where the parcel is just delivered goes in line2, not here. Send "" to remove a company saved before. Only if the customer gave it.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code ("ES" for Spain). Only if the customer gave it.

email.description: The email address, nothing else. Only if the customer gave it.

first_name.description: The first name of the person, nothing else. Never a greeting, a yes or a label: "Yes", "Ok", "Hello", "Address" or "Name" are not names. Only if the customer gave it.

last_name.description: The surname or surnames, nothing else. Only if the customer gave it.

line1.description: Street and number only ("Calle Mayor 1", "Carrer de l'Exemple 9"), without the word "address", the floor or the postcode. Only if the customer gave it.

line2.description: Floor, door or staircase only ("3º A", "2n 1a", "bajo"), if given. Only if the customer gave it.

note.description: A note for the order, only if the customer asked for one

phone.description: The phone number, digits and an optional + prefix. Only if the customer gave it.

postcode.description: The postcode only. Only if the customer gave it.

region.description: The province or region, only if given. Only if the customer gave it.

session_id.description: Only if your client does not keep the MCP session (the Mcp-Session-Id header): the session_id that an earlier answer of this server gave you. It keeps the same cart between calls.

text.description: ONLY if you cannot separate the details into the fields: what the customer wrote about themselves, exactly as they wrote it. When you pass any separate field, text is ignored.

vat_id.description: The tax or VAT ID exactly as given (keep a country prefix such as "ES"), without the label. Only if the customer gave it.

name: checkout_set_customer
